changes: Expose cognitive lifecycle handles to the workbench IPC adapter.
Expose the existing stop-and-clear operation for an explicit workbench pause.
Limit sandbox filesystem reads to this isolated npm dependency directory.
Use minecraft-data 3.119.0 to match the installed protocol libraries and declare the runtime TypeScript dependency.
Inherit the runtime working directory when Windows rejects a sandbox cwd of 260 or more characters; retain absolute entry paths and the existing filesystem permission roots.

Spell out the same sandbox-source and npm dependency subtrees in filesystem read permissions to avoid Windows MAX_PATH directory auto-detection failures, without granting parent or sibling directories.
Expose placeBlockAt for exact-coordinate building using native world objects, exact inventory matching, occupied-target protection, and verified placement results.
Exclude dynamically registered workbench peer bots from cognitive chat and pause control while retaining visible chat history and human or explicit workbench instructions.
